text: To keep bank-system liquidity ample, the People’s Bank of China will on Aug 14, 2026 conduct a CNY1 trillion buyout-style reverse repo via a fixed-quantity, interest-rate tender with multiple-price allotment. The operation carries a six-month (185-day) tenor and will mature on Fe
text_zh: 为保持银行体系流动性充裕，中国人民银行将于2026年8月14日通过固定数量、利率招标、多重价格中标方式开展1万亿元人民币买断式逆回购操作。该操作期限为六个月（185天），将于2月到期。
